India has long been at the heart of the global diamond trade, with generations of workers building expertise in cutting and polishing diamonds.
Now, lab-grown diamonds are opening up new possibilities for the industry, from growing diamonds locally to changing how a new generation thinks about jewellery and luxury.
With the Government of India recognising lab-grown diamonds as a key emerging sector for the future, the industry is witnessing a significant shift.
In conversation with Pooja Madhavan, founder and managing director of Limelight Diamonds - India's largest lab-grown diamond jewellery brand - we explore the people and ideas shaping this evolving industry.
